rv.q: British drama doesn't get better than this.
My Night with Reg is the most artificial and the truest, the funniest and most searing play to be found anywhere on the London stage.
This is a first-rate revival of a first-rate play: an exceptional ensemble in a cannily plotted, adroitly painful story.

It takes the form of an excruciating comedy of gay manners, a tragedy of Greek proportions tempered with comedic punchlines to ease the pain. It’s a play that requires a delicate balance and Ryan struggles at times to strike the right tone.

cn.t: This acclaimed 20th-anniversary revival of Elyot's modern classic earns praise for its delicate balance of poignant comedy and tragedy, with precision direction revealing the timeless writing's beauty and emotional depth.
